raw_text: 西部战区后勤部队正沿G219公路向阿克赛钦前沿地区输送物资。车队约30辆军用车辆，包括工程车辆和通信设备。这与每年六月的常规轮换部署一致，但规模明显大于往年。新的预制掩体建设已基本完成。
clean_text: Western Theater Command logistics forces transporting supplies along G219 to Aksai Chin forward areas. Convoy of 30 military vehicles including engineering and comms equipment. Scale larger than previous annual rotations.
